changelog:
### Minor Changes

- ae917b4: Add `@shop-prompter/vue`, a Vue 3 component wrapping the `<shop-prompter>` Web Component.

  - Typed props, passed to the element as DOM properties, so objects and callbacks need no `.prop` modifier and no `isCustomElement` compiler option.
  - Listen with `@cart-operation`, `@product-click`, `@navigation` and `@close`.
  - A template ref exposes `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`, `isOpen` and `element`.
  - `dialog-trigger` also accepts a Vue template ref.

### Patch Changes

- @shop-prompter/html@2.2.0

integration.description: The ShopPrompter® Vue SDK adds the AI shopping assistant to Vue 3 applications as a typed `<ShopPrompter>` component, including Nuxt.
integration.overview:
Render `<ShopPrompter>` in any Vue template and configure it with typed props for the configuration, theme and display mode. It wraps the ShopPrompter® Web Component, so every display mode and theme option of the JavaScript SDK is available without any compiler configuration.

Listen to `@cart-operation` and `@product-click` to connect the assistant to your cart and router, and use a template ref to open or close the chat from your own UI.

prerequisites.title: A ShopPrompter® API key or token
